tweets.text:
Starting the Fiscal Year STRONG!

The first month of FY26 continues to prove one thing- the border is secure, and the results speak for themselves. USBP closed out the month with only 9,845 apprehensions- maintaining under 10,000 every month since January. 

 * 258 daily average apprehensions- 95% lower than the daily average encounters under the previous administration (5,110/day, Feb 2021- Dec 2024)
* CBP total encounters 30,561- 79% lower than October 2024- LOWEST OCTOBER in CBP history! 
* EVEN BETTER- Zero releases for six straight months 

 We're not slowing down. This is sustained control, and we are not easing our grip.
#HonorFirst

The Mexican national, traveling on a commercial bus, presented a fake U.S. Legal Permanent Resident card to the agent. Agents immediately spotted discrepancies and ran his biometrics. 

The results were shocking. The 54-year-old has a conviction for Criminal Sexual Acts with a minor, Lewd Acts victim under 14, served 4 years in prison and is a deported felon. He is facing prosecution for felony illegal reentry. 

Thanks to our highly trained agents, this sexual predator was stopped and unable to make it into our communities.  @USBPChiefRGV

$1.9 MILLION WORTH OF FENTANYL SEIZED! 

A USBP K9's sharp nose stopped a deadly load of fentanyl from hitting our streets. The U.S. citizen driver was arrested and now faces federal prosecution under 21 USC 841.
